programme.title: Hemsley + Hemsley - Healthy and Delicious S01 - On the Go
programme.desc: Life is busy these days and what with work and our hectic social lives, lots of us are on the go all the time. The Hemsley sisters help us not to fall for quick fix fast food with healthy and clever nutrient rich recipes that are also perfectly portable. No fry muffin frittatas packed with fresh veg and ingenious chicken noodle pots with spiralized veg make a healthy lunch even eaten at your desk. And the girls' signature paradise bar is a sweet treat to get you through the afternoon.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy S01 - Stress-Free Cooking
programme.desc: Mary joins AJ Odudu on a beautiful local allotment to teach her the joy of stress-free cooking. AJ tries her hand at a luscious tiger prawn courgetti and a rich aubergine bhuna.

programme.title: Donal's Real Time Recipes S01 - Nostalgic Nights In
programme.desc: Taking inspiration from the recipes he grew up with, Donal shares some firm family favourites that would be a hit in any household. For those who like a big bite, he's got the ultimate steak sandwich, using Donal's favourite cut for speedy dinners, that you'll be dreaming about days later.

programme.title: Donal's Real Time Recipes S01 - End of Week Wizardry
programme.desc: By the time Friday rolls around, there is often a fridge full of odds and ends you want to use up before getting the big shop done. Donal's got four recipes that make the most of leftovers and fridge scraps. There's a moorish cauliflower mac and cheese, using old breadcrumbs and chorizo. Making magic from whatever veggies are hanging around the chiller, Donal makes Korean-style veggie pancakes with gochujang.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee S08 - EP9
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes the four semi-finalists into the Sewing Room to celebrate the influences of Japanese design and sewing. For the Pattern Challenge, Esme has collaborated with a Japanese designer to come up with a kimono-inspired dress that proves to be a brain-teaser.

programme.title: Listing Mauritius S01 - EP1
programme.desc: In this episode, Mridula reveals incredible luxury in the Anahita Resort in Beau Champ, Samuel is working in La Balise, Rinie and Manon show a huge estate in Bel Hombre, Grahame is in Tamarina in Tamarin West, and Nawsheen reveals a beautiful home in Mont Choisy on the North of the island.

programme.title: Bake Off: The Professionals S09 - Petit Gâteaux & Suspended Showpieces
programme.desc: The final six hero the humble apple, celebrate autumn, spotlight trending ingredients and build a full 'World of Candy' complete with pâtisserie pick 'n' mix. Who'll get a taste of sweet success?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off S15 - EP2
programme.desc: It's Biscuit Week and the bakers make Viennese sandwiches, a retro minty favourite and dramatic puppet theatres. Who'll take centre stage, and who's delivered their final act?

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Stuck
programme.desc: All of the Teletubbies are stuck. Tinky Winky's hand is stuck in the bag, Dipsy's hat is stuck, Laa-­Laa's ball is stuck and Po is stuck on the Tubby Slidey!

programme.title: Yakka Dee S02 - Bubble
programme.desc: In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say 'bubble' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see bubbles of all shapes and sizes - big bubbles, tiny bubbles, shiny bubbles and rainbow bubbles. We pop bubbles, try to catch bubbles, blow bubbles and even meet some bouncing bubbles. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Messy's Mega Power
programme.desc: The Oki-dokis are about to perform when OKIDO runs out of electricity! Anxious that their favourite band might not be able to play, can Messy and his friends find a new way of powering the concert?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Pirate Parade
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him! Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Shadowlands
programme.desc: On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. Coco keeps taking shortcuts so Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Favourite Thing
programme.desc: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.desc: The Squirrels are getting ready for the same woodland adventure, but their mornings all look slightly different.

The Squirrels quickly learn that the short films they are enjoying are only trailers before the film starts. programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Bioluminescent Bay, Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Glitch's bath time puts the creatures of Puerto Rico's Bioluminescent Bay in bubble-trouble.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Gobi Desert, Mongolia
programme.desc: Glitch's giant drill causes a dino-disaster for the team's fossil hunt in the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Kenji on the Rails Again
programme.desc: When Kenji hears that he must travel home to Japan alone, he gets scared and tries to hide. So, Thomas sets out to find him

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Bench Blocked
programme.desc: When Sarah and Duck's favourite bench is in use, the pair find other things to do in the park.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Planetarium Aquarium
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck go to the aquarium to track down a waving fish.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Circus
programme.desc: The cicrus bus has broken down, but the children are waiting for a circus show! Can Stanley help out?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Stuck
programme.desc: Stanley has to free Myrtle, who is stuck, using his new tunnelling mole machine so she can attend the schools tree planting day.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons
programme.desc: From tickles and piggybacks to no longer being able to do cartwheels, grandparents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to post a picture
programme.desc: JoJo has drawn a picture to show Great Gran Gran over a video call, but just as she's about to show it, the internet goes down! Gran Gran suggests they post JoJo's picture to Great Gran Gran in Saint Lucia. JoJo learns why a letter takes such a long time to travel halfway across the world.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Music Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go too. Several pots, balloons, tins, tubes and some water later and the Squirrels are making music. And boy, are they LOUD!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Nomads, Mongolia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is out on a camping expedition in Mongolia. There's not much around except a group of Mongolian nomads - people who travel around the country with their animals, camping in amazing tents called gers. Glitch visits their camp and inadvertently offends them, then his misfiring jetpack causes him to land on one of their precious horses, causing it to gallop away from the camp with Glitch on its back!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Chilli Peppers
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bagpipe playing Chilli Peppers, melting Kiwi backstage and performing their song "We're Chilli When It's Hot!"

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Grapefruit
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Grapefruit, dedicating the song "All My Friends" to the close pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Runner Bean
programme.desc: Supertato and Runner Bean are competing for first place in this year's supermarket race, but Evil Pea has plans to win by cheating.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - The Evil Peamobile
programme.desc: Evil Pea builds her own Evil Peamobile - and it has more gadgets than the Tatocar! It's Carrot's job to make the Tatocar even better before the two cars to go head-to-head.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Musical Statues
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po enjoy a game of musical statues. It takes the Teletubbies a few turns to work out what to do when the music stops; they must stand very still.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S02 - Tummy
programme.desc: Yakka Dee! celebrates children communicating - because talking fills you up with whizz, pop, bang! In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say 'tummy' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a drummy tummy, a furry tummy, a squeaky tummy and some silly tummies. There are hungry tummies, a tickly tummy and even a very special tummy with a baby inside! The journey is repeated with some surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Sneezy Wheezy
programme.desc: Everyone in OKIDO has been kept awake by a mysterious sound. Messy and his friends go to find its source and discover that the giants need their help.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Pigs Might Fly
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo are great at picking apples with Mojo's crane top. But Preston's drone might be even better... until it accidentally scoops up Felix. Mojo and Bo are on the chase!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Bishop Rock Lighthouse, Isles of Scilly
programme.desc: Glitch plunges the sea into darkness in a night-time adventure near the Isles of Scilly.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Bbq
programme.desc: It's lunchtime on Bluey's deck! But the BBQ needs a salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousins asked for!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: When a pterosaur destroys Jen's dino proximity machine, Andy goes on an adventure to retrieve the pieces. Along the way, he meets velociraptors, an Alamosaurus and some hungry Gorgosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Hedgehog
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Sing Song Forest, where Tincy the Spider needs help from the Playtimers to wake up her furry friend, Hedge the Hedgehog.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The List Badge

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung's relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou's favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the defence of the Great Wall at Gubeikou, seven Chinese soldiers are separated from their main force and tasked with defending the strategic outpost of Badaolouzi. Vastly outnumbered by Japanese troops and tanks, they make a last stand, fighting to the end in a powerful display of sacrifice and patriotism.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao - EP20

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: Inspector Lau plans the murder of his father-in-law and shifts the suspicion away. When his wife grows suspicious, she hires his close friend, private investigator Bong, to uncover the truth. As the plot unravels, Lau escalates his schemes to silence all threats, leading to a deadly showdown between former friends.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesn’t know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. When Harper can’t sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Escape The Backpack Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spark Bees Best in Show
programme.desc: The kids scare away a swarm of bees. But when they realize bees make the flowers happy, they hatch a plan to get them back! When Scallop makes a bad choice, Kelp helps her learn from her mistakes.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Superfan Barb
programme.desc: Kelp and the rest of his friends put on a game of rainbow ball, but Kelp begins to wonder how well his special spark can help him truly measure up to his favorite player. When the underwater friends meet someone new, they’re reminded that their differences make them unique.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - New Hat, New Tag! Furry Tail Ending
programme.desc: When Tag worries that she's no longer a "Go" dog, Lady Lydia helps her find a new persona by helping Tag try on a bunch of different hats. Luckily, when a runaway puppy needs to be wrangled, and only the speedy Tag can catch him, Tag realizes she was a Go dog all along. \ Sergeant Pooch reads Scooch, Tag and Kit a story book during their sleepover. But when the last pages are missing, the three kids work together to make up their own ending to the story.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Bigpaw, Big Problems Captain Scooch and Scally-Tag
programme.desc: Tag, Scooch and Kit think they found the perfect story for their newspaper: Bigpaw is in Pawston! But when they find out that Frank and Beans were lying to the town, they seek to uncover the truth and reveal it to everyone. \ When Sam Whippet sets up a pirate-themed race for the Race Cadets, pirate-loving Scooch takes on the role of captain. Tag struggles to take orders as first mate while helping Scooch navigate maritime obstacles and avoid the fearsome pirates.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Treasure Riders
programme.desc: When a swashbuckling adventurer named Waldondo comes to town, the Riders enthusiastically join him on a treasure hunt for a priceless gem.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Puff Enuf
programme.desc: The Riders find a Puffertail and train her to join the family. She struggles to learn but soon finds herself with a chance to make a big rescue.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Snow Day
programme.desc: When a snowstorm blocks Kate from accessing the zoo, Melman decides to become “substitute Kate” and make sure the animals are cared for. But when the animals go wild in the snow, Melman’s future-paramedic skills are put to the test during an outbreak of stubbed toes and boo-boos. A series of stumbles makes Melman question whether he’s cut out to be a paramedic--until he learns that mastering a goal takes grit!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Hermit Fab
programme.desc: When Gloria meets a shy hermit crab, named Starlene, with a secret talent of tap dancing, Gloria plans a flashy production for Starlene’s debut so she can share her talent with the world! But Gloria doesn’t ask Starlene what she wants, and pushes the crab’s introverted self too far, ultimately learning you have to respect your shy friends' comfort levels they may be different than yours.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Three Trolls-keteers The Helper
programme.desc: When a neighbor asks Guy for help to fight a monster, Guy mistakes it as an invite to act in his playSmidge sets out to help Troll Village but creates disastrous results

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Smidgician DJ's Got Talent
programme.desc: Smidge tries to rescue the Trolls after thinking she has magical powers DJ Suki tries to impress her favorite niece CJ Suki

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - Flock The Boat
programme.desc: When the pirates show up in San Lorenzo with Tranche trying to find a kidnapped Captain Alonso, Puss and Tranche try to “out hero” each other

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - All Hail, Puss!
programme.desc: With the earthquakes in San Lorenzo becoming unmanageable, Puss turns to the sky gods, who give him mighty powers

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Girl Who Cried Wolf
programme.desc: Lucky, Spirit and the PALs rescue a lone wolf pup and keep it hidden in town until it can be returned to its mother.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Endless Possibilities
programme.desc: When Aunt Cora throws a career day at school, Lucky struggles to figure out what she wants to be when she grows up.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - A Rider's Balance
programme.desc: After meeting her riding idols, Pru vows to practice until she's perfect — even if it means missing out on a bonfire her best friends are planning.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Welcome Back Otter
programme.desc: Abigail puts herself at risk to reunite an orphaned otter with his family. But the school veterinarian insists the animal will be safer at the zoo.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Battle of Tianshang Part 1
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Battle of Tianshang Part 2
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Pangea-ing
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Boss tries to rename the local soccer team to "The Babies", but after Danny gets involved in the popularity race with his name, "The Hot Dogs", the town becomes divided. Boss creates a crack team of Baby Corp employees to game plan solutions to the worst outcomes.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Night Owls
programme.desc: Boss arranges a sleepover with Quiet Psycho Baby to get access to her father the Mayor's day planner, hoping to plant his own pro-baby agenda. However, staying up all night has the unexpected consequence of delusional over-tiredness! Tim sneaks into an art film and decides he has to be a grown-up now, so Mom and Dad try to "kid" him up again.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - OCB
programme.desc: Boss' reign as CEO is threatened by a charming, multiple-dimpled Outside Consultant Baby (OCB) hired by the Board of Directors. Boss, furious that OCB will ruin Baby Corp with his poorly thought out ideas, tries to distract him while Staci adds the finishing touches to a project that will make OCB unnecessary, The 24 Hour Diaper.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Hollywood Beginning
programme.desc: Three months after their battle in the arctic, the team is back in L.A. with one major change: they’ve been fired as Spy Racers! Most of the team is able to easily readjust to civilian life: Frostee is trying to get his license and Layla is a professional stunt driver in the biggest movie franchise in the world. But Tony can’t rest; his gut is telling him that Dann is still out there and is plotting to destroy L.A. and he’ll stop at nothing to prove it.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Dann Hunt
programme.desc: Tony was right; Dann is back and she’s been spotted all around Los Angeles! The Spy Racers get back together on an unofficial mission to bring her down! Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere, Palindrome and Roscoe run their out bounty hunter operation.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Wildcat
programme.desc: The team realizes they can’t stop Dann on their own, so they call in Ms. Nowhere for backup. While they try to come up with a game plan, Dann ambushes them! It’s a knock-down-drag-out brawl all through Los Gatos as they try to keep Dann from getting the mysterious devices she’s collecting. In their time of need, they turn to the last person they ever thought they’d ask for help: Cleve Kelso.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Crash Course
programme.desc: When a dangerous subterranean Cavern Crasher dragon invades the Fireworm Queen's underground nest, she approaches the Riders on Dragon's Edge for help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Follow The Leader
programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragon's Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Turn And Burn
programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Blade of the Red Phoenix
programme.desc: Po and the kids are recruited to perform in Mei Mei's theatrical show, but things take a turn when Jindiao ruins the play in order to find a mystical scroll

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - The Intruder Flies a Crooked Path
programme.desc: When Jindiao arrives to the Village, he invites the kids to participate in an exhibition match, but has alternative motives

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - A Fistful of Herbs
programme.desc: When Po discovers he was poisoned, he sets off to a caravan oasis in the hopes of finding out who the perpetrator is, unknowingly followed by the kid

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R &amp; D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling “Adult Babies” before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits frames Boss and Tina’s startup company for exploding baby Iggy’s favorite stuffed animal, and Tina is forced to the sidelines to avoid any more bad press. As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Heat is On
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict “no-babies” policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.desc: 清朝咸豐年末，大清因長期以來的閉關鎖國政策，國勢已盛極而衰，西方各國憑藉著船堅砲利，大舉入侵中國。在這個動亂的時代，一段恩怨糾葛的愛恨情仇、揉合著保家衛國的壯烈故事就此展開...

programme.title: 民視晚間新聞
programme.desc: 民視提供即時政治、國際、財經、生活、社會、地方、娛樂最真實的報導、最多元的內容，掌握最新消息、生活動態，都在民視新聞。

programme.title: 豆腐媽媽第201集
programme.desc: 一部以傳統手工豆腐為核心的戲劇，將故事將圍繞著「萬家」的豆腐老店，雖然看似平凡，卻因為「一個家庭三個姓氏」以及「豆腐秘方只傳姓萬的男丁」的家訓，埋下了充滿衝突與矛盾的伏筆。

programme.title: 姊妹亮起來第353集
programme.desc: 民視全新時尚生活消費節目《姊妹靚起來》邀請到主持人梁赫群與于子育在今天熱鬧開錄，一出場主持人就介紹粉橘色的全新時尚佈景，讓大家驚呼連連，于子育提到現在女生獨立自主知道怎麼消費、怎麼買，節目什麼都能聊，聰明消費生活就是流行時尚，冷面笑匠梁赫群說就是有我這種「剎車皮」來告訴大家冷靜，也把新知潮流給大家，節目上除了藝人來賓，還有專家與各行各業的姐妹淘來賓，把最棒的資訊、產品、哪裡好吃好玩甚至潮流精品，帶給觀眾朋友。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.desc: 縱有疾風起

programme.title: 新北厚所在第15集
programme.desc: 深耕新北市的13家有線電視業者聯合製播「新北厚所在」，除了延續第一季以人文、歷史、地景、風俗的豐富內容外，第二季將加入新住民、原住民及性別平等的議題，讓節目內容更為豐富多元。

programme.title: 南國有藝思第15集
programme.desc: 生活裡總有巧思，每一片土地上，也總有些人正揮灑自我能力，讓生活或生命與眾不同，有些是基於對土地的熱愛、有些是興趣、有的則是正在逐夢。節目從文化、創意的角度出發，探訪地方人、地方事，看這些在地人物，如何活出生命的精采，也讓屏東這塊土地有了更豐潤的底蘊。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第336集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 2025揚州講壇第10集
programme.desc: 2025揚州講壇

programme.title: 生活智多星第1842集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間佛學院第62集

programme.title: 生活智多星第1843集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第337集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 新北厚所在第16集

programme.title: 幸福在我家第34集
programme.desc: 葉彰棋和三個兄弟，兄友弟恭，互相提攜，同心協力和父母一起拓展布店的生意，卻在家庭事業一帆風順時，母親突然因車禍意外身亡。他思索命運的意義，陷入算命的迷思。年少失學的遺憾，讓彰棋對子女的學業要求嚴格，得失心很重，卻又屢屢受挫；進入慈濟才體悟了，「要以菩薩的智慧來教育自己的小孩，以媽媽的愛心來愛普天下的孩子」，學會放手，讓孩子走自己的路。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第730集

programme.desc: 王池堃自小立志當個音樂老師，不料家裡很窮無法供應他學琴。考上師專後為了趕上進度，王池堃每天早上四點鐘起床搶琴房苦練鋼琴。他嚴以律己的態度也用於教學上--不論是對於學生與他的小孩都是非常的嚴厲，因此大家都很怕他。接觸慈濟之後軟化了王池堃的脾氣，為了推動環保，他承擔三峽國小衛生組長的工作，放下身段的親自打掃廁所。退休之後進入教聯會扛起攝影機擔任人文志工。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第30集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第46集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 行動現場第442集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 大愛夜安新聞 LIVE

programme.title: 人間菩提

programme.title: 聽見心的聲音第4集
programme.desc: 王池堃自小立志當個音樂老師，不料家裡很窮無法供應他學琴。考上師專後為了趕上進度，王池堃每天早上四點鐘起床搶琴房苦練鋼琴。他嚴以律己的態度也用於教學上--不論是對於學生與他的小孩都是非常的嚴厲，因此大家都很怕他。接觸慈濟之後軟化了王池堃的脾氣，為了推動環保，他承擔三峽國小衛生組長的工作，放下身段的親自打掃廁所。退休之後進入教聯會扛起攝影機擔任人文志工。

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6891集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第693集
programme.desc: 在日本昭和年代，傳統觀念認為女人必須走進家庭、相夫教子。但女主角寅子（伊藤沙莉飾）卻無懼禁忌，不僅考進大學研讀法律，更成為日本第一位女律師！爾後她為了幫助在戰爭中受到苦難的孩童與女性，努力奔走成立家事法院，並且打破歧視，擔任日本首位女法官……

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1161集

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第18集

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第598集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2090集

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第570集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2091集

programme.title: 錦衣之下第29集
programme.desc: 天賦異稟的六扇門女捕快袁今夏（譚松韻飾）因為一樁案件和性情狠辣的錦衣衛陸繹（任嘉倫飾）結下樑子，本是道不同不相為謀，卻因驚天密案聯手。兩人從水火不容到情難自已，命運的糾葛就此旋轉一起。

programme.title: 霹靂朝靈闕第3集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，無暇暗劫起，猂族利用地獄鳥力量，動盪苦境之後，雌伏多年的暗劫八無暇，也趁勢再出，為阻止這股邪惡勢力顛覆中原武林，湯問夢澤山座白象．香六牙，廣發天下舉鋒帖，召開擎天會，聚集西窗月、墨如鴉、不全鷹等湯問英傑，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道釋代表相繼響應，血漫河山俠骨烈，亙古之爭，勝敗由天抑由人？

programme.title: 社會NOW什麼第13集
programme.desc: 超精彩的社會現象、社會觀察以及社會檔案內幕分析都在社會NOW什麼！

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第37集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 少年白馬醉春風第7集

programme.title: 霹靂朝靈闕第5集

programme.title: 我們的島第1377集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 阿蒂美髮店第1集
programme.desc: 鳳珠阿嬤（呂雪鳳飾）將透天厝一樓出租給印尼新二代阿蒂（許安植飾）開美髮店，這十年來，唯一陪伴在鳳珠阿嬤身邊的人就是阿蒂，也只有阿蒂可以忍受鳳珠阿嬤吵死人的毛病，兩人老是鬥嘴，這棟透天厝總是鬧哄哄，如今因為印尼母親的緣故，阿蒂必須拋下一切、去印尼展開新生活。鳳珠阿嬤經歷過喪女之痛，希望阿蒂與母親重逢，卻又不捨阿蒂離去，內心百般掙扎，阿蒂就要離開了，鳳珠阿嬤會做出什麼樣的舉動吸引阿蒂的注意？能成功將阿蒂挽留下來嗎…？

programme.desc: 四位同為二十歲出頭的好朋友:想活出自我勇敢的冠徵，男孩子氣息的帥妹小靜、甜姐兒品妤，還有木訥的阿雄，他們各自離開自己家裡，住在一起生活著，不管是在工作上、或感情上的人生探索，他們彼此碰撞，有時相互鼓勵、有時會有爭吵...年輕可能會憋憋扭扭、也可能有無限的發展性，在成長的道路上，每個人的形狀都不一樣，這四個好朋友遇上了彥儀這樣年紀相當的女孩，也認識了像魏涵任這樣成熟的女人，在生命中的未可知變化，就這樣在二十歲之後展開了...

programme.desc: 苦力是指從事勞動工作，以付出勞力來維生的廉價勞工。他們大多在碼頭負責貨物的裝卸、建筑地盤的運輸工作。從中國出發到外國工作的苦力，歷史上稱之為華工。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第972集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 維他命施第346集
programme.desc: 施以諾的心靈維他命，別自找憂鬱，讓喜樂上門！

programme.title: 真情部落格第206集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 福氣人生第764集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第428集
programme.desc: 跟隨寇紹恩牧師，每天五分鐘，領受上帝的話語，並將其應用到實際生活中。這樣我們可以每天都在上帝的愛和恩典中浸泡。

programme.title: 經典音樂河第102集
programme.desc: 節目中除了膾炙人口的聖詩演唱和演奏外，還有旁白將詩歌背後的故事和歌詞意境生動地道出來。同時，精彩的台灣大自然景觀影片作為背景，為觀眾帶來視覺上的享受。節目的目標是在聽覺、視覺和心靈層面上陪伴觀眾，在他們每一天的生活中營造美好的時光。

programme.title: 恩雨之聲第649集
programme.desc: 梁燕城博士和譚品立牧師將攜手帶領觀眾進行一場精彩的旅程，探索世界各地的基督教遺跡，深入研究這些地方的文化根源。他們將帶領觀眾欣賞廣闊而壯麗的風景，讓大家的眼界得到拓展。

programme.title: 生命真道之豐盛人生第512集
programme.desc: 基督徒必看的節目。它的系列節目叫做「生命真道」，每週一播出。在這個節目中，我們邀請了來自國內外的講員，他們通過深入的教義解釋和精闢的信息，向教友們傳達神的信息。

programme.title: 生命轉折點第9集
programme.desc: 大衛耶利米牧師以他深入淺出、精準又嚴謹的教導，將上帝永恆不變的真理傳達給聽眾。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第26集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 當晝新聞第273集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第27集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 荒野求生全明星第3季:第9集
programme.desc: 演員斯特林K布朗與貝爾一同深入科羅拉多的高山，他們在那裡與驟降的氣溫搏鬥，還要爬下幾近垂直的岩石縱截面，並且追蹤一頭行蹤不定的鹿，再從一座瀑布垂降到地面。

programme.title: 演化第1集
programme.desc: 克里斯帕克漢踏上了一場非凡的時空之旅，去揭開像大象這樣體型龐大、結構複雜且充滿魅力的生物，究竟是如何演化而來的。從四十多億年前的一個微小細胞，一路蛻變成地球上最具代表性的巨獸之一，這是一段讓人大開眼界的生命演化故事。

programme.title: 終極苦旅第4季:第3集
programme.desc: 加入瑞恩的團隊，探索蘇黎世城市之美，接著從列支敦斯登首都瓦杜茲出發，踏上大遠征，前往日內瓦湖畔小鎮蒙特勒。《終極苦旅》本次旅程將分為上下集播出。

programme.title: 古文明帝國崛起第6集
programme.desc: 古文明帝國熬過了數個世紀，毀滅卻近在眼前。誰將導致他們的殞落？又是誰將創造出流傳千古的遺贈？

programme.title: 搶標房地產第1季:第19集
programme.desc: 從加州來的寇特和克莉絲汀娜一鳴驚人，第一天就標下了一棟房子。約翰回到老家附近，成功贏得利潤豐厚的房子。艾德和史蒂夫雖然也標下房子，但屋內有個問題壁爐，他們究竟能賺錢還是賠錢呢？

programme.title: 搶標房地產第1季:第20集
programme.desc: 艾德和史帝夫標下位在醫院前方的房屋。史考特以超低價錢買下一棟外觀很破爛的房屋。約翰順利搶標下今天他們看到外觀最吸引人的房屋，究竟哪棟房屋能賺錢，哪棟又會讓買家賠錢呢?

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第12季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集節目要介紹的是大量生產的葡萄酒和耐穿耐寒的防水透氣外套。 黃尾袋鼠是全世界最暢銷的葡萄酒品牌之一,一年會生產1億1千5百萬瓶。 葡萄從葡萄園採收並來到釀酒廠,經過壓碎,發酵,過濾和混釀,就成了超市架上的完美混釀酒。 期間釀酒師必須一再品嚐葡萄汁和發酵過的酒液,以確保葡萄酒品質能達到標準並符合顧客期望。 過去登山和滑雪者最大的問題就是衣服材質不是不防水,就是防水卻不透氣。 現在有了戈爾公司研發的防水透氣布,做出的外套不僅能抵抗風雨,更能讓人體保持乾燥舒適,是現代人的一大福音,征服高山似乎變得更容易了。

programme.title: 美國製造第1季:第13集
programme.desc: Discovery 頻道致力製作全世界最高素質的野生紀實、科技工程、歷史文明、求生探險、動力改造等主題紀錄影片。

programme.title: 翻新中古車第13季:第2集
programme.desc: 麥克買到一台80年代最受歡迎的豪華敞篷車款，賓士560SL。可惜這台車的懸吊過軟，內裝也略顯疲態。他們將讓這台車經歷一場麻雀變鳳凰的大轉變。

programme.desc: 派克發起大賺三千五百萬的目標，甚至不惜挖走對手的成員。東尼見好就收，順利收穫豐厚報酬。瑞克的當務之急則是找到新礦地。

programme.title: 幹盡苦差事第9季:第9集

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第12季:第5集

programme.title: 美食大揭密第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，主持人要帶大家前往美國南方，一窺美味甜食背後的祕密。包含結合巧克力、花生、焦糖、棉花糖的「糊糊棉花糖」，白底紅條紋的薄荷軟糖，蜂蜜麵包還有櫻桃汽水。

programme.title: 用魚叉獵黑鮪第1季:第4集

programme.title: 白令海大吸金第13季:第12集
programme.desc: 冬季最後一天，各路採金客無不把握最後機會完成最後一潛。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第20季:第10集
programme.desc: 德魯普里察與同行薇琪諾特和阿利斯特德萊堡結伴上路，拜訪多名古董商界的可靠合作夥伴。

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第4季:第15集
programme.desc: 艾倫在員工面前強顏歡笑，但其實他很想念與夥伴湯合作的時光。這天他前往長堤拍賣會場，沒想到竟然遇到了湯。原來湯因為度假花了不少錢，所以打算到拍賣會場賺一筆。兩個冤家不期而遇，氣氛緊張。同時現場有個行徑誇張的對手，他在拍賣業界有花錢不眨眼的名號，這使得艾倫無法單獨與對方硬碰硬競標。在最後關頭，兩人決定集結彼此的現金，用最大的資源標下倉庫，也因此重新開啟兩人對話的機會。

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第4季:第16集
programme.desc: 「海夫湯當鋪」慘淡經營已有段時間，貨架顯得有點空盪。由於因為存貨很少，所以生意不太好。大姊想出一個很棒的點子，那就是舉辦當舖估價日活動，吸引客戶帶古董來估價；同時湯和艾倫要去參加久違的週六拍賣會，希望能為當鋪補些存貨。想不到拍賣會的倉庫不盡理想，艾倫和湯兩人空手離開現場，心情十分沮喪。就在回家的路上經過家庭式的車庫大拍賣，由於當地以前是很早開發的富裕地區，所以挖寶機會大增，讓湯和艾倫兩人喜出望外。

programme.title: 追謎探險隊第10季:第9集
programme.desc: 喬許要聯手《金礦的賭注》名人派克雪納普，共同挖掘價值千萬美元的失落寶藏。

programme.title: 層層透視古文明第5季:第14集
programme.desc: 本集的層層透視古文明，主題是馬雅文明古城「帕倫奎」的三位女王。這三位女王做了那些貢獻、對城邦又有何種影響？帕倫奎作為馬雅文明數一數二興盛的城邦，又是怎麼走向沒落的？節目請到多位學者專家，替大家解惑，解開神秘的馬雅銘刻文字、講解馬雅的權力興衰。

programme.title: 人體內的怪物第8季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集透過病人或親屬口述介紹三種怪病。史蒂芬強森症候群是一種罕見但嚴重的免疫系統疾病，它會侵犯皮膚和黏膜；醫界對史蒂芬強森症候群的認識不多，通常有兩個比較常見的原因：一是病毒感染，例如肺炎或HIV病毒，二是藥物反應。絲蟲病是一種人畜共通疾病，這種寄生蟲可能影響身體許多部位，如果進入皮膚或關節，會引發皮膚絲蟲病而導致皮膚病變、關節痛和發炎；但如果絲蟲進入淋巴系，就可能導致可怕的象皮病。浣熊蛔蟲症非常罕見，全世界可能不到100個病例，但這種寄生蟲會傷害大腦，大部分是難以復原的損傷，甚至死亡。

programme.title: 好萊塢人魔第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 知名摔角家族馮埃里克一家的最後成員將講述名聲、成癮問題和家族詛咒帶來的悲劇故事。

programme.desc: 蘿倫和卡莉都想幫丈夫進行驚喜翻修。蘿倫家的空間是客房加辦公室，由設計師道格與嘉熙出馬，用壁畫壁紙、訂做書桌、天篷雙人床和鄉村風改造邊桌等，為丈夫朱爾打造舒適的辦公區，外加讓客人好好休息的客房。卡莉則要為丈夫派翠克翻修娛樂室、辦公室兼臥房。由羅伯和妮可量身打造具有美感的禪之牆、放置電玩設備的角落擱架，及家庭照做成的大拼貼畫，讓派翠克脫離如宿舍般的狹隘空間，在此舒適放鬆。

programme.title: 管教惡貓第4季:第16集
programme.desc: 住在舊金山的亞當與珊曼莎養了一隻惡貓吉絲莫，但他們打算在不久後生小孩。小孩的安全讓他們擔心，亞當認為如果無法管教好吉絲莫，就打算讓牠安樂死，但貓咪行為學家傑克森絕對無法接受這種事情，因此要盡力挽救。黎恩跟史蒂夫交往6年，他們的貓黛西今年6歲並患有貓感覺過敏症。這種症狀的貓咪會不斷攻擊自己的身體，這對情侶讓黛西接受過各種治療，牠必須服用很多藥物，這不僅造成經濟上的負擔，也影響了雙方的感情。傑克森要設法改善牠的症狀，讓兩人的感情恢復正軌。

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 澳洲動物園明年就要慶祝五十週年慶了。為了迎接這一天，動物園內的鱷魚展示區正在進行重修。在修期間，原本在展示區內的短吻鱷都要被遷移到另一個大池中。這是羅伯特第一次捕捉鱷魚。為了能順利捕捉到所有短吻鱷，捕捉人員會分成兩人一組，用食物把池裡的短吻鱷都吸引出來，一次把牠們全都捕捉起來，免得有些短吻鱷看到同伴被捉，就躲到水池裡，這樣就更麻煩了。在第一次捕捉中，他們捉到五隻短吻鱷。因為貨車的後車廂只裝得下四隻，捕鱷大師托比便決定讓其中之一坐在前座。

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 為了尋找可能已經滅絕的南洛磯山野狼，佛瑞斯特將爬上內華達山脈並在雪地追蹤神秘的掠食者。

programme.title: 野地刺客第4集

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 寵物計畫診所的仁心收費口碑已經傳至千里，只有12週大的拉布拉多犬瑞亞出了車禍，造成後腿兩處嚴重骨折，因為住家附近的獸醫院診斷必須截肢，所以狗主人琴娜大老遠連夜從愛荷華州開車到丹佛市，就是為了希望傑夫醫生能挽救愛犬的腿。寵物計畫診所積極投入社區公益，傑夫醫生和獸醫技師海克特前往一處狼犬收容所，為狼犬健康檢查和打疫苗，此事讓海克特非常緊張。另外，貝爾醫生擔任獸醫已經20多年，但他竟然從來沒有為貓狗動過截肢手術，因為他頭15年我擔任動物園獸醫；今天他將為一隻天生腿部殘缺的貓咪進行他的第一次截肢手術。

programme.title: 地球好驚奇第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集探索的是非洲最大的野生動物庇護所恩戈羅恩戈羅火山口，美國大峽谷，島嶼天堂波拉波拉島，以及冰島的火山冰川。

programme.title: 百變水族箱-如魚出水
programme.desc: 本集是百變水族箱的特集，布瑞和韋德兩人走訪杜拜，體驗世界最大的購物中心和最大的水族館。亞特蘭蒂斯棕櫚酒店位於一座人工島上，從外太空看形狀像是一株棕櫚樹，酒店內有1700間客房，還有許多水族館。館內有一座1100萬公升水量的水族箱，正面有個長寬7.6公尺的大片觀景窗，厚度約61公分，在酒店各處都設有觀景窗，因此不論客人身在何處，都能一窺水底世界的景象。韋德和布瑞不但有機會進入鯊魚繁殖中心，直接協助鯊魚取精授精工作，同時還能進入大型水族箱裡享受親手餵魚的難得機會。

programme.desc: 本集節目中，野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特將前往加勒比海大巴哈馬，尋找據說已經絕種的西印度僧海豹。

programme.title: 百變水族箱-如魚出水
programme.desc: 本集是百變水族箱的特集，布瑞和韋德兩人走訪杜拜，體驗世界最大的購物中心和最大的水族館。亞特蘭蒂斯棕櫚酒店位於一座人工島上，從外太空看形狀像是一株棕櫚樹，酒店內有1700間客房，還有許多水族館。館內有一座1100萬公升水量的水族箱，正面有個長寬7.6公尺的大片觀景窗，厚度約61公分，在酒店各處都設有觀景窗，因此不論客人身在何處，都能一窺水底世界的景象。韋德和布瑞不但有機會進入鯊魚繁殖中心，直接協助鯊魚取精授精工作，同時還能進入大型水族箱裡享受親手餵魚的難得機會。

programme.title: 萬塔拉-保育園區紀實第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 佛瑞斯特與萬塔拉攜手合作，照顧近期獲救的動物。

programme.title: 管教惡貓第4季:第1集
programme.desc: 傑克森蓋勒克西這次來到舊金山，有兩家客戶亟待拯救。一對母女因為一隻又瞎又聾的凶猛異國短毛貓蓓柏莉而發生爭執，母親認為蓓柏莉沒有生命品質，應該接受安樂死，女兒不喜歡母親的這個想法，傑克森首度接受如此複雜的案子。另一對夫妻家裡養了兩隻貓和一隻小狗，一天到晚發生的貓狗大戰使這對夫妻不敢生小孩，無法展開新的家庭生活，體力和情緒都瀕臨崩潰。傑克森來到他們的家檢視空間環境，發現了問題所在。傑克森是否能順利幫這些客戶解決問題？

programme.title: 地球好驚奇第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集探索的是非洲最大的野生動物庇護所恩戈羅恩戈羅火山口，美國大峽谷，島嶼天堂波拉波拉島，以及冰島的火山冰川。

programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶、太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶。 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型、甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星。兔寶寶、太菲鴨、傻大鳥、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼。 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界。

programme.title: 見見超級蝙蝠車第1017集
programme.desc: 他們是一群打擊犯罪、擁有知覺的超能車輛，跟著蝙蝠俠、羅賓、蝙蝠女還有許多DC超級英雄一起捍衛高譚市。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第39集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。

programme.title: 人魚獨角獸-星落第112集
programme.desc: 某個神奇夜晚，一群獨角獸順著一顆流星劃過天際，墜入神秘的海洋，變成了半獨角獸、半魚的奇幻生物。有一天，當它們追逐遷徙的海豚時，他們首次發現了人類世界的水面。從此，關於「人魚獨角獸」的傳說便流傳開來──據說，它們只會在月食時現身。

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠第102集
programme.desc: 湯姆貓和傑利鼠的主人要搬家了，牠們成了無家可歸的流浪漢，遇到了傷心的小女孩羅比，她的監護人菲格姨媽是一個壞心腸的女人，企圖侵吞羅比爸爸留下的億萬財產。羅比逃出後，菲格姨媽為了抓到羅比，還想出了懸賞百萬捉拿的詭計。還好羅比的爸爸趕了回來，菲格姨媽的陰謀破滅，而湯姆和傑瑞也有了更大更漂亮的房子，只是牠們之間的戰爭可沒那麼容易就結束呢！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go第449集
programme.desc: 《少年悍將！GO》是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目。也是DC系列《少年悍將》漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗、嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活。本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現。

programme.title: 愛煩多王子冒險中第5集
programme.desc: [丹麥片]為了尋找黃金羽毛，愛煩多王子與他的隨從伯特必須經歷重重關卡，前往雄鷹之山，在這過程中他們將遇見各式各樣的挑戰。本作是以每集一個單元的方式播出的小短劇。

programme.title: 天兵公園第40集
programme.desc: 在一個名為「青黏公園」的私人擁有的公園中，鳥哥和阿天來到這裡應徵工作。這個公園充滿了令人捧腹大笑的情節，大部分都是關於日常生活的事情，但都被賦予了「超出常態」的發展。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第121集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go第211集
programme.desc: 《少年悍將！GO》是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目。也是DC系列《少年悍將》漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗、嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活。本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現。

programme.title: 農場雞動隊第124集

programme.title: 難捕第121集
programme.desc: (2019)榮獲艾美獎提名的奇趣系列強勢加盟卡通頻道！兩位瘋狂科學家－Specs Doc 和 Skinny Doc拚了命也要捉回難捕!這隻從實驗室裡逃脫的黏TT橙色生物！可是身 為偽裝界變身達人的難捕~就像他的名字一樣難捕! 哪有那麼簡單就被捉回去! 看來這兩位瘋狂科學家的日子只會更加失控!更加混亂!

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第121集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第9集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第7集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶、太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶。 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型、甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星。兔寶寶、太菲鴨、傻大鳥、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼。 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界。

programme.title: 見見超級蝙蝠車第1018集

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第40集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。

programme.title: 人魚獨角獸-星落第113集
programme.desc: 某個神奇夜晚，一群獨角獸順著一顆流星劃過天際，墜入神秘的海洋，變成了半獨角獸、半魚的奇幻生物。有一天，當它們追逐遷徙的海豚時，他們首次發現了人類世界的水面。從此，關於「人魚獨角獸」的傳說便流傳開來──據說，它們只會在月食時現身。

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠第103集
programme.desc: 湯姆貓和傑利鼠的主人要搬家了，牠們成了無家可歸的流浪漢，遇到了傷心的小女孩羅比，她的監護人菲格姨媽是一個壞心腸的女人，企圖侵吞羅比爸爸留下的億萬財產。羅比逃出後，菲格姨媽為了抓到羅比，還想出了懸賞百萬捉拿的詭計。還好羅比的爸爸趕了回來，菲格姨媽的陰謀破滅，而湯姆和傑瑞也有了更大更漂亮的房子，只是牠們之間的戰爭可沒那麼容易就結束呢！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go第451集
programme.desc: 《少年悍將！GO》是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目。也是DC系列《少年悍將》漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗、嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活。本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現。

programme.desc: [丹麥片]為了尋找黃金羽毛，愛煩多王子與他的隨從伯特必須經歷重重關卡，前往雄鷹之山，在這過程中他們將遇見各式各樣的挑戰。本作是以每集一個單元的方式播出的小短劇。

programme.title: 天兵公園第14集
programme.desc: 在一個名為「青黏公園」的私人擁有的公園中，鳥哥和阿天來到這裡應徵工作。這個公園充滿了令人捧腹大笑的情節，大部分都是關於日常生活的事情，但都被賦予了「超出常態」的發展。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第123集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go第213集
programme.desc: 《少年悍將！GO》是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目。也是DC系列《少年悍將》漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗、嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活。本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現。

programme.title: 小小樂一通大學第115集
programme.desc: 跟著佩絲及巴斯兔、甜甜鳥、哈姆豬和膽大鴨的腳步，看他們在兔巴哥、太菲鴨和其他傳奇卡通人物的指導下學習成為專業卡通人物所需的一切。

programme.title: 難捕第101集
programme.desc: (2019)榮獲艾美獎提名的奇趣系列強勢加盟卡通頻道！兩位瘋狂科學家－Specs Doc 和 Skinny Doc拚了命也要捉回難捕!這隻從實驗室裡逃脫的黏TT橙色生物！可是身 為偽裝界變身達人的難捕~就像他的名字一樣難捕! 哪有那麼簡單就被捉回去! 看來這兩位瘋狂科學家的日子只會更加失控!更加混亂!

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第122集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第10集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。
